result.quote: For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.”
result.reason: Verse 11:15 directly gives the reason Athaliah was brought out before being killed: Jehoiada had prohibited killing her in the house of the LORD. The palace grounds in verse 11:16 are therefore the resulting place of execution. The edit preserves the original intended fact and answer scope.
